how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online only, in two parts, through the official BPSSC website.
Visit bpssc.bihar.gov.in and go to the "Home Guard" tab, then click the link for Advertisement No. 11/2026.
Complete Part 1 (Registration) with name, nationality, mobile number, email ID, Bihar domicile status, reservation category, gender, and date of birth, then make the online fee payment.

After successful registration and payment, a registration number and password will be sent via SMS and email - use these to log in and complete Part 2 of the form with father's/husband's name, mother's name, address, and educational qualification details.

Upload a recent colour photograph (taken within the last 2 months, white background, 15–25 KB, JPG/JPEG/GIF format) and a scanned signature (black or blue ink, on white background, 15–25 KB, JPG/JPEG/GIF format).
Review all entered details carefully using the "Edit Details" option before final submission - no edits are possible once the application is confirmed and submitted.
After final submission, download and print the Acknowledgement on A4 size paper and retain it for future reference and correspondence.
Note: Only one online application can be submitted per candidate and per mobile number. Submitting more than one application will lead to rejection of all applications by that candidate.

content_sections.heading: BPSSC Company Commander Vacancy 2026 – Category-wise Details
content_sections.text: A total of 65 vacancies have been notified for the post of Gulma Samadesta (Company Commander), to be filled from eligible Home Guards. The category-wise breakup, including the 35% horizontal women's reservation and 2% horizontal reservation for grandchildren of freedom fighters, is given below. Note: Reservation benefits, including the 35% horizontal reservation for women, are admissible only to original residents (domicile) of Bihar. Candidates from other states in a reserved category will be treated as Unreserved category candidates.

content_sections.heading: BPSSC Company Commander Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: This recruitment is not open to the general public. It is restricted to candidates already serving within the Bihar Home Guard organization who meet the following conditions. Must be an Indian citizen. Men, women, and third gender Home Guards may apply. Must be enrolled and trained in the Bihar Home Guard Vahini organization. Must have completed at least 5 years of service/duty in the organization. Must have at least 10 years of remaining service left as on the cut-off date considered for appointment (i.e., the application cut-off date). Must meet the physical and educational qualifications prescribed for the post. Candidates must have passed a graduate examination from a recognised university, or an equivalent examination recognised by the State Government, on or before 01-08-2026. Chest measurement is not applicable for women candidates. A minimum expansion of 5 cm is required for men after fully expanding the chest. For third gender (Kinnar/Kothi/Hijra/Transgender) candidates, the physical standards and physical efficiency test criteria will be the same as for Backward Class (BC) candidates. No marks are awarded for height, chest, or weight - candidates simply must meet the prescribed minimums to qualify; those who don't will be declared unsuccessful.

content_sections.heading: BPSSC Company Commander Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit will be calculated as on 01-08-2026, based on the date of birth recorded in the Matriculation or equivalent certificate. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: BPSSC Company Commander Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection to the post of Company Commander will be made through a written competitive examination in two phases, followed by a Physical Efficiency Test, as detailed below. The Preliminary exam covers General Knowledge and Current Affairs. Candidates scoring less than 30% will be declared unsuccessful for the Main exam. Successful candidates will be shortlisted for the Main exam at 20 times the number of vacancies, category-wise, in merit order (this ratio may be reduced if sufficient qualified candidates are not available). A negative marking of 0.2 marks per wrong answer applies in both the Preliminary and Main examinations. The answer sheet will be prepared in two copies, one of which will be retained by the Commission. Minimum qualifying marks for the final merit list (based on Main exam Paper 2): SC, ST, and Women candidates – 32%; EBC candidates – 34%; BC candidates – 36.5%; General category candidates – 40%. Based on Main exam marks, candidates will be shortlisted for the PET at 6 times the number of vacancies, category-wise, in merit order. The PET is qualifying in nature only. Candidates get a maximum of three attempts each for the high jump, long jump, and shot put. Candidates who fail to complete the race within the prescribed time will not be permitted to attempt the other events. Candidates must qualify separately in every event. Third gender candidates follow the same PET standards as the Backward Class category. The final merit list will be prepared category-wise based on marks obtained in the Main written examination (Paper 2). In case of a tie, preference will be given first by date of birth (older candidate ranked higher), then by higher educational qualification, and finally by alphabetical order of name as per the 10th board certificate.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Matriculation / equivalent certificate (for date of birth verification) Graduate degree certificate / equivalent qualification certificate Certificate of at least 5 years' service/experience as a Home Guard, issued by the Bihar Home Guard Vahini headquarters Caste/category certificate, where applicable, issued by the competent authority Permanent residence (domicile) certificate, where applicable Non-creamy layer certificate, where applicable Income and asset certificate for EWS candidates (valid only if issued per the specified 2026 order, as stated in the notification) Recent colour photograph and signature scan (as per specifications above) Note: The notification specifically states that for a married reserved-category woman candidate, the caste certificate and permanent residence certificate must be submitted based on her father's category, not her husband's - since caste is determined by birth, not marriage. Submitting a certificate based on the husband's category can lead to rejection of candidature.

faq.question: Q1. What is BPSSC Company Commander Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a promotion-based recruitment drive by the Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission to fill 65 posts of Gulma Samadesta (Company Commander) in the Bihar Home Guard Vahini, open only to eligible serving Home Guards.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BPSSC Company Commander Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 65 vacancies have been notified across General, SC, ST, EBC, BC, EWS, and BC Women categories.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for BPSSC Company Commander Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only Home Guards enrolled and trained in the Bihar Home Guard Vahini, with at least 5 years of service and at least 10 years of remaining service as on the cut-off date, who also meet the educational and physical eligibility criteria, can apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for BPSSC Company Commander Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window is open from 10 September 2026 to 10 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for BPSSC Company Commander?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed a graduate examination from a recognised university, or an equivalent examination recognised by the State Government, by 01-08-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for BPSSC Company Commander Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 24 years and the maximum age is 50 years, calculated as on 01-08-2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for BPSSC Company Commander Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹100/- for all categories, payable online via net banking, debit/credit card, or UPI.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for BPSSC Company Commander Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves a Preliminary written exam, a Main written exam (General Hindi + General Studies/Science/Maths paper), and a qualifying Physical Efficiency Test (race, high jump, long jump, shot put), followed by a category-wise final merit list.
